title: Maximum depth of a binary tree
summary: Every branch asks its two children how deep they go, adds one for itself, and reports the larger answer upwards.
goal: Count the floors on the longest path from the top to a leaf

mapping.formal: Nodes on the longest path down from it

ladder.name: List every path to a leaf
ladder.idea: Walk every path from the root to each leaf, keeping the whole path, and measure the longest.

ladder.name: Ask the children
ladder.idea: The depth of a node is 1 plus the larger of its children's depths; an empty child has depth 0.
ladder.insight: Only the length of the deepest path matters, not the path itself. Each node can combine two numbers from its children.

transfer.problem: Find the number of floors in an organisation chart, from the CEO down to the most junior employee.
transfer.explanation: Each manager's depth is one plus the largest depth among their reports: the same recursion.

selfCheck: Adds one for the current node.
Takes the larger of the two children.
